crop_bop_dataset_images: crop RGB and depth images in a BOP dataset to a target size and save them
update_camera_intrinsics_after_crop: update scene_camera.json camera intrinsics to account for cropping offsets after center-cropping images
crop_segmentation_masks: crop mask and mask_visib segmentation images to match the cropped RGB and depth image dimensions
load_bop_split_params: load dataset split parameters including scene IDs, image paths, and target image size using dataset_params
verify_cropped_dataset_completeness: verify that the cropped dataset output directory contains the same number of files as the source
